name: cloud-vault-mcp
description: MCP server — READ-ONLY personal data access (vault metadata, identity, comms, media, finance, health)

native_build._cmd_doc: npm install, not npm ci: this service has no committed package-lock.json.

app._public_doc: MESH ONLY. This server hands out vault material, so it is not routed on the public edge hostname at all -- not even behind Authelia. containers.app.public:false is what the mcp.json deriver reads (see 1_cloud-configs/src/derive/derive-mcp-json.ts: the gate is app.public && proxy.parent_domain && proxy.base_path, NOT proxy.primary.wg_only), so leaving it true kept emitting https://mcp.diegonmarcos.com/cloud-vault-mcp/mcp into every client list even though proxy.primary.wg_only was already true. Clients now reach it by direct mesh IP via the direct_http block in cloud-u-linux/da_my-ai/data/claude/mcp-policy.json -- the same shape cloud-cgc-pvt-mcp uses. It stays present in BOTH client templates; only the transport changes.

mcp.description: READ-ONLY personal data access: vault metadata, identity docs, communications, media, finance, health (redacted).
